Implementation.criterion_name: Quality and efficiency of the implementation
Implementation.source_section: Section 1 (Evaluation) — Criterion 3: Quality and efficiency of the implementation

compliance_checklist.description: Individual criterion threshold: each of the three criteria must score at least 3 out of 5.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Important Notice — Thresholds & weighting; Section 1 per-criterion 'Threshold: 3/5'

compliance_checklist.description: Overall threshold: the sum of the three individual scores must reach at least 10 out of 15.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Important Notice — Thresholds & weighting; Section 1 'Total score / Overall threshold /15'

compliance_checklist.description: Scope of the application: the proposal must correspond, wholly or in part, to the topic description against which it is submitted.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 (Other Questions) — Scope of the application

compliance_checklist.description: Exceptional funding: any third-country participant or international organisation not listed in the General Annex must be justified as essential to the project.
Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC): the proposal must declare whether it involves hESC and, if so, justify necessity.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 (Other Questions) — Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC)

compliance_checklist.description: Use of human embryos: the proposal must declare whether it involves human embryos and, if so, explain their use.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 (Other Questions) — Use of human embryos

compliance_checklist.description: Activities excluded from funding: the proposal must not include human reproductive cloning, heritable genetic modification, creation of embryos for research or stem-cell procurement, or destruction of human embryos.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 (Other Questions) — Activities excluded from funding

compliance_checklist.description: Exclusive focus on civil applications: the proposed activities must be intended exclusively for civil applications.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 (Other Questions) — Exclusive focus on civil applications

compliance_checklist.description: Lump-sum cost assessment: for this lump-sum topic, evaluators must assess the cost estimations and record approval or recommendations for the lump-sum budget in the evaluation report.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2 (Other Questions) — Assessment of lump sum cost estimations (IER/CR options for lump sum topics)
